t: You're facing the Kimpton Fitzroy London, a historic five-star hotel on Russell Square in Bloomsbury. It opened in 1900 and was known as the Hotel Russell until 2018. The architect was Charles Fitzroy Doll, who specialised in designing hotels in the Victorian and Edwardian eras. There's a famous connection here: he based the dining room he designed for the RMS Titanic on his dining room for this hotel. So part of this building's interior lives on in the story of that ship.
